<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    柱状图模板
    用途: 类别数据对比
    适用场景: 销售额对比、区域排名、年度数据对比
    支持: 6个柱子（可调整为3-8个）
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 柱状图渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="barGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="barGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="barGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F57C00;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="barShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各区域销售额对比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="115" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年第三季度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1160" y2="550" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="450" x2="1160" y2="450" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="350" x2="1160" y2="350" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="250" x2="1160" y2="250" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="1160" y2="150" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="555" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>0</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="455" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>50</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="255" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>150</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="155" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>200</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- X轴和Y轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="140" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1160" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 柱子数据 (柱宽50px, 间距130px, 总间距180px) -->
        
        <!-- 柱子1: 华东 - 185M (370px高度, 每100M=200px) -->
        <rect x="220" y="180" width="50" height="370" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="245" y="165" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>185</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="245" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华东</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子2: 华南 - 142M -->
        <rect x="400" y="266" width="50" height="284" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="425" y="251" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>142</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="425" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华南</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子3: 华北 - 128M -->
        <rect x="580" y="294" width="50" height="256" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad1)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="605" y="279" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>128</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="605" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华北</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子4: 西南 - 96M -->
        <rect x="760" y="358" width="50" height="192" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad2)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="785" y="343" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>96</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="785" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>西南</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子5: 华中 - 73M -->
        <rect x="940" y="404" width="50" height="146" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad2)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="965" y="389" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>73</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="965" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>华中</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 柱子6: 东北 - 52M -->
        <rect x="1120" y="446" width="50" height="104" rx="4" fill="url(#barGrad3)" filter="url(#barShadow)"/>
        <text x="1145" y="431" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>52</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1145" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>东北</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="920" y="620" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad1)"/>
        <text x="945" y="632" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高增长区域 (>100M)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="920" y="645" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad2)"/>
        <text x="945" y="657" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>稳定区域 (50-100M)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="920" y="670" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#barGrad3)"/>
        <text x="945" y="682" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>潜力区域 (<50M)</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="60" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6">
        <tspan>数据来源: 销售部门统计</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="1100" cy="150" rx="300" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="550" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接线 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M100,200 Q250,150 350,220"/>
        <path d="M350,220 Q450,280 500,200"/>
        <path d="M900,480 Q1000,420 1100,480"/>
        <path d="M1100,480 Q1150,550 1200,500"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 蓝色节点 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="100" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="220" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="480" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="480" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="1200" cy="500" r="4"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 橙色节点 -->
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.7">
        <circle cx="1050" cy="180" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1150" cy="120" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="520" r="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 左上角装饰短线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="60" width="80" height="4" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="2"/>
    
    <!-- 品牌标识 -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{BRAND_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="300" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="365" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="400" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 引用语 -->
    <text x="640" y="465" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7" text-anchor="middle">
        "{{TAGLINE}}"

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F8FAFC"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 顶部橙色装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#D97757"/>
    
    <!-- 页面标签 -->
    <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{PAGE_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 页面标题（核心观点） -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 三列卡片布局 -->
    <!-- 卡片1 - 绿色（推荐/成功） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="130" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#10B981">💡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="90" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="90" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="130" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">{{CARD_1_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片2 - 蓝色（流程/架构） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#4A90D9" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="530" cy="250" r="35" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="530" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#4A90D9">⚡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="490" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="490" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="490" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="530" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4A90D9">{{CARD_2_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片3 - 橙色（关键洞察） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="860" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#D97757" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="930" cy="250" r="35" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="930" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#D97757">⚙️</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="890" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="890" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_3_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="890" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_3_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="890" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="930" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#D97757">{{CARD_3_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 页码 -->
    <text x="640" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">
        {{PAGE_NUM}} / {{TOTAL_PAGES}}
    </text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 结束页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.15"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.02" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="200" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    <ellipse cx="980" cy="500" rx="280" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接装饰 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M150,150 Q250,100 350,180"/>
        <path d="M350,180 Q420,250 380,320"/>
        <path d="M950,400 Q1050,350 1100,420"/>
        <path d="M1100,420 Q1150,500 1080,550"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 节点装饰 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.5">
        <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="180" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="380" cy="320" r="4"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="950" cy="400" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="420" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1080" cy="550" r="5"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 感谢语标签 -->
    <text x="640" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="3">
        THANK YOU
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主感谢语 -->
    <text x="640" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{THANK_YOU}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="350" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 副标语 -->
    <text x="640" y="410" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{TAGLINE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 联系信息卡片 -->
    <rect x="440" y="460" width="400" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.05" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
    
    <text x="640" y="505" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{CONTACT_NAME}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.6">
        {{CONTACT_URL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部分隔线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="640" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{COPYRIGHT}}
    </text>

</svg>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

Welcome to the 9th edition of JavaScript Rising Stars. Each year, this report ranks JavaScript projects by the number of GitHub stars added over the past 12 months, using the Best of JS curated project list. [Pause]

Today we'll walk through the top projects of 2024, unpack the biggest ecosystem shifts, and identify the trends that will shape JavaScript development heading into 2025.

Key points: ① Methodology: GitHub stars added in 2024 ② 9th annual edition ③ Curated by Best of JS
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_overall_top10

[Transition] Let's start with the headline numbers — the ten projects that gained the most stars in 2024.

shadcn/ui dominates with 38,000 stars added, a full 41% more than the runner-up Excalidraw at 27,000. [Data] That gap of 11,000 stars is larger than the total gained by most projects on this list. [Pause]

The top 10 spans a remarkable range: from UI components and collaboration tools to API testing, workflow automation, and backend-as-a-service. Notice that several AI-adjacent projects made the cut — n8n, Flowise, and Supabase all cracked the top 10.

Key points: ① shadcn/ui's 38k gap vs. #2 ② Diverse project categories ③ AI-adjacent tools prominent
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_shadcn_deep_dive

[Transition] Given that lead, let's dig deeper into shadcn/ui's extraordinary run.

Created in January 2023, it gained 39,500 stars in its first year and followed up with 38,000 in 2024 — only a 4% decline, which is remarkable sustained momentum for any open-source project. Its total now stands at 77,500 stars. [Pause]

What drove this? In 2024, the project shipped Charts powered by Recharts, a Themes system using CSS variables, Blocks for common layouts, and a responsive sidebar component. But the real catalyst was the upgraded CLI that now supports Next.js, Remix, Vite, Laravel, and monorepos — plus a new registry system that spawned an ecosystem of derivative libraries like Motion-Primitives and Magic UI.

Key points: ① Back-to-back champion with only 4% YoY decline ② Seven major feature additions in 2024 ③ Registry ecosystem enabling derivative libraries
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_frontend_frameworks

[Transition] Now let's zoom in on the front-end framework rankings, where the most surprising shift of 2024 happened.

htmx overtook React to become the number one framework by stars added — 16,800 versus React's 14,200. [Pause] htmx extends HTML with hx-* attributes to handle data fetching and interactivity without writing JavaScript, making it ideal for server-driven applications.

React 19 finally shipped in December after three years of development, bringing Server Components, Server Functions, and Custom Elements support. Robin Wieruch notably observed that React is evolving from a library into "a specification for frameworks." Meanwhile, Svelte 5 introduced runes for explicit reactive state and earned the highest positive opinion in the State of JS survey.

Key points: ① htmx overtakes React — HTML-first gains traction ② React 19 shifts toward framework specification ③ Svelte 5 runes earn top developer satisfaction
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 05_react_ecosystem

[Transition] Despite htmx's framework crown, the React ecosystem itself remains massive. Let's look at the top 5 projects within it.

shadcn/ui leads at 38,000, followed by Excalidraw at 27,000 and Payload at 14,400. [Data] Magic UI, a shadcn/ui derivative with 13,200 stars, shows the power of the registry ecosystem we discussed. Next.js rounds out the top 5 at 12,100. [Pause]

The bigger narrative here is React's evolution. With Server Components and Server Functions in React 19, frameworks like Next.js and Remix now interpret React's primitives differently. React is less a standalone library and more a specification that frameworks implement — a fundamental shift in how we should think about the React ecosystem.

Key points: ① shadcn/ui dominates React ecosystem at 38k ② Magic UI validates the registry ecosystem model ③ React's shift from library to framework spec
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_vue_ecosystem

[Transition] On the Vue side, the ecosystem tells a story of growing maturity and confidence.

Nuxt leads with 6,200 stars, followed by PrimeVue at 5,400 and Slidev at 4,700. Notably, shadcn-vue — a Vue port of shadcn/ui — gained 4,100 stars, showing the copy-paste component model is crossing framework boundaries. [Pause]

Under the hood, Vue 3.5 reworked its reactivity system, with the lighter alien-signals approach already landing in the main branch. Daniel Roe from the Nuxt core team highlighted the active release cycle and regular performance improvements. The flourishing of UI libraries — PrimeVue, shadcn-vue, VitePress — signals that Vue's ecosystem has reached a confident, self-reinforcing maturity.

Key points: ① Nuxt leads Vue ecosystem growth ② shadcn model crosses framework boundaries ③ Vue 3.5 reactivity rework signals technical maturity
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_emerging_themes

[Transition] Stepping back from individual frameworks, three cross-cutting themes defined the JavaScript landscape in 2024.

First, AI integration is everywhere. n8n at 17,000 stars, Flowise at 14,500, and Supabase at 14,500 all feature significant AI capabilities. [Data] Four of the top ten overall projects have AI as a core feature — it's no longer a differentiator, it's table stakes. [Pause]

Second, Tauri's 15,900 stars demonstrate that developers want lighter desktop and mobile apps built with web technologies — an Electron alternative with smaller bundles and lower memory usage.

Third, browser-based innovation continues to expand what's possible client-side. PGlite runs a full Postgres database via WebAssembly entirely in the browser. WebVM is a complete virtual machine running in-browser. The browser is becoming a universal runtime.

Key points: ① AI capabilities are table stakes ② Tauri pushes lighter desktop/mobile apps ③ Browser becoming a universal runtime via WASM
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

[Transition] Let me close with five actionable takeaways for 2025.

One: component ownership beats imports. shadcn/ui's model of letting developers copy and own code proved its staying power for a second consecutive year. Two: HTML-first is serious. htmx passing React validates that server-driven, low-JavaScript architectures have real momentum. [Pause]

Three: React is becoming a framework specification. Plan your architecture around specific framework implementations, not React alone. Four: AI integration is now table stakes — if your tooling doesn't have an AI story, it's falling behind. Five: Vue's ecosystem has matured into a confident, self-reinforcing platform.

As you plan your 2025 technology decisions, these five trends should inform your framework choices, tooling investments, and architectural directions. Thank you.

Key points: ① Own your components ② Take HTML-first seriously ③ React = spec, pick your framework ④ AI is mandatory ⑤ Vue ecosystem is mature
Duration: 2 minutes
